encoding.program: UTF-8; reject invalid UTF-8 and NUL before effects
encoding.document: Read saved file bytes, recording their encoding, BOM and newline policy with the captured disk revision. Native byte modes and external processes use those saved bytes. Text transforms decode that captured representation and retain explicit source mappings. Unsaved drafts are separate from command inputs.
encoding.ordering: unsigned byte lexical order; no ambient locale

excluded: shell options other than errexit, nounset and pipefail

rules.array_index: Array indexes must be from 0 through 9223372036854775807.
rules.splitting: Unquoted expansions split on the current IFS (space/tab/LF when unset) then glob; quoted expansions retain one argument. A NAME=value prefix applies to one reached command.
rules.globs: Sort byte order; exclude hidden names unless requested; unmatched patterns stay literal; never traverse symlinks. Preserve existing ** whole-component matching of zero or more nonhidden directories, bounded visits/matches and no symlink descent.
rules.substitution: Reached units only; strip trailing LF bytes; refuse NUL scalar; failure prevents containing dispatch; never reparse output.
rules.admission: Validate complete submitted unit before effects; bind computed arguments when reached. Source captures and validates its own unit, retaining earlier parent effects.
rules.dispatch: Native names bind first. Missing native forms may dispatch a confined installed binary and record native_gap for native repair. Host-inspecting commands stay native and session-scoped. Other programs dispatch confined. external -- explicitly selects an installed binary. timeout, nohup and env use this dispatch for COMMAND, with its own receipt. No shell fallback; fallback never bypasses a host refusal.
rules.paths: The working directory is absolute: pwd, PWD and OLDPWD hold native paths, cd moves between attached folders by absolute path or @label and resolves .. logically unless -P. Relative operands resolve from the statement cwd. An unquoted leading @label or @scratch expands to the folder native absolute path in every argv and assignment value; quoted it stays literal; an unknown label stays literal and a retired one refuses. native_path converts explicitly. Neither grants access. TMPDIR, TMP, TEMP and SCRATCH_DIR name the real session scratch for natives and processes; mktemp uses it. Literal /tmp keeps its OS meaning. Null redirects use typed device sinks.
rules.statuses: Last executed ordinary status; pipelines use rightmost nonzero after expected early closure. Grep/diff comparison 1 remains complete. Host terminal reasons latch and prevent later admission.
rules.publication: When current authority permits, publish this session’s accepted agent-only drafts through separate admitted write operations before a reached owner opens its inputs. Read-only profiles read saved bytes without publication. Every redirected producer must be typed eligible and complete; native grep/diff comparison 1 qualifies, unclassified external nonzero does not. Capture destinations after preparation, stage bytes, review, validate and publish per target. Never pre-truncate or replay a producer.
rules.evidence: Execution pins differ from conversational delivery. Only delivered exact mapped cat/head/tail/nl ranges qualify an edit base; unseen output and arbitrary transforms do not.
rules.jobs: Session jobs have numeric references: real OS PIDs for external processes and session-unique numbers for native jobs. Capture cwd/environment, bound lifetime/output, allow cancellation only for this session; no interpreter checkpoints.
rules.secrets: References remain opaque except declared authorized sinks; inserted bytes never become grammar.
rules.progress_update: Optional existing update_progress payload; validate envelope/program before either effect; progress owner settles independently before gated effects. Zero-program-effect fresh resubmission references never imply zero progress effects.
rules.parameters: Support $name/${name}, indexed arrays a=(...) / a+=(...) / a[i]=v / ${a[i]} / "${a[@]}" / "${a[*]}" / ${#a[@]} / ${#a[i]}, $0 program identity, $1..$9/${10} positional values, $# count, $? ordinary prior status, $! latest background process number (real OS PID for external jobs, session number for native jobs). Quoted "$@" preserves each positional operand and expands to zero arguments for zero parameters; "$*" joins with single spaces. ${#name} returns Unicode scalar length. ${name-word}, ${name:-word}, ${name+word}, ${name:+word}, ${name?word} and ${name:?word} select by set/non-empty state (the colon form treats empty as unset) and expand the word only when selected; ? refuses the containing command. ${name#pat}, ${name##pat}, ${name%pat} and ${name%%pat} remove the shortest/longest matching prefix/suffix; ${name/pat/word}, ${name//pat/word}, ${name/#pat/word} and ${name/%pat/word} replace the first/every/leading/trailing longest match; ${name:offset} and ${name:offset:len} slice Unicode scalars or array/positional elements; ${name^}, ${name^^}, ${name,} and ${name,,} convert case. Patterns are shell globs with quoted text literal. ${name=word} and ${name:=word} assign the expanded word in the current frame when the parameter is unset (or, with the colon, empty) and expand to the value; positional and special parameters reject assignment. $(( )) evaluates wrapping signed 64-bit integers with + - * / % ** << >> & | ^ ~ ! comparisons && || ?: and parentheses; operands are decimal, 0x hexadecimal or leading-zero octal literals or variables holding one (unset or empty is 0); division by zero, negative exponents and non-integer values refuse; assignment, ++ and -- reject inside $(( )) and are supported inside (( )) arithmetic commands. Single quotes preserve bytes. Double quotes escape only dollar/backtick/double-quote/backslash/LF; backslash-newline is removed. Windows native paths preserve backslashes when single quoted.
rules.grouping: { statements; } shares current frame; ( statements ) runs isolated cwd/variables frame with independently settled child effects. ! negates ordinary command/pipeline status only, never a terminal host stop.
rules.here_documents: <<DELIM expands supported variables/substitutions unless delimiter quoted; <<-DELIM additionally strips leading literal TAB from body/delimiter. No word splitting/globbing of body. <<< WORD expands WORD like a double-quoted argument and feeds it with a trailing LF. Captured body bytes count against unit and here_document_bytes caps; no direct shell execution.
rules.braces: Unquoted {a,b}, nested lists, preambles/postscripts, {x..y} and {x..y..step} integer ranges (zero-padded when an endpoint has a leading zero) and single-letter ranges expand command words, for items and array elements before every other expansion; assignment values, here-strings, parameter words, tests, case and arithmetic keep braces literal. Admission refuses a word expanding past expanded_fields, a zero step and an integer..letter range before any effect.
rules.functions: NAME() { statements; } only, names cannot shadow reserved language words or native built-ins. Functions shadow external names. Positional arguments local to frame; export/environment follows invocation frame. Assignments alone update current frame; preceding NAME=value scopes one dispatch. source shares current frame; no cross-invocation persistence.
rules.status_details: Ordinary status is0..255; explicit exit/return out-of-range rejects. test false1, misuse2; true/:0, false1. Failed substitution prevents containing command even when ordinary error handling could continue the outer sequence.
rules.budget_counting: AST nodes count selected parser syntax nodes, including words/redirects, excluding comments; depth is parent edge count from unit root. Each reached statement and loop test/iteration charged before admission, including empty bodies. Engine-specific query/regex instructions are not equated: work steps count host-observable value/record/match transitions. Adapters use their declared work, cancellation and allocation bounds; uninterruptible allocation must isolate/refuse. Work steps do not measure CPU time.
rules.envelope: Optional progress_update payload identical to existing update_progress schema. Other command envelope capabilities/verification remain unchanged until introducing dependent PRs. Prevalidate envelope and complete syntax unit before applying progress. Valid progress remains recorded after later program failure. Fresh zero-program-effect resubmission references bind exact rejected program/source/catalog identity and remain explicit human/model actions.
rules.source_encoding: Submitted/source syntax units are UTF-8 without BOM or NUL. Source -- captures original representation and refuses unsupported encoding/BOM at reached-unit admission, retaining prior parent effects. SourceSpan offsets name those exact UTF-8 captured bytes, not re-encoded UTF-16 bytes.
rules.aggregate_memory: Variable_count and per-value bounds do not authorize their product allocation. Charge aggregate state and intermediate expansion memory before allocation, including simultaneous old/new values; refuse before exceeding invocation caps.
rules.effective_limits: Here-doc bytes count within program/source-unit bytes; effective admissible body size is min(here-document remaining, enclosing source/program bytes after syntax). Counter-boundary fixtures isolate counters; complete golden programs must satisfy all dimensions. argv/environment ceilings are host maxima; platform launch also applies frozen OS argv+environment bound and rejects COMMAND_OPERAND_INVALID before spawn if narrower, preserving native/external dispatch semantics.
rules.settlement_reservation: Inside aggregate trace ceilings reserve32 events/16384 bytes PER live child execution plus32/16384 for the parent and, when separately admitted,32/16384 for progress. Count simultaneous native stages, external/background jobs and held effects cumulatively. Admit no child unless every already-started execution plus parent/progress retains its own final-settlement reservation. Release a reservation only after authoritative settlement; elapsed time or stop acknowledgement cannot release it. Exhaustion closes new admission while started work settles from reserved capacity. Never drop terminal facts; storage failure follows existing host-fault/owner recovery semantics.
rules.parser_memory: Reserve parser scratch against the enclosing program before parsing; charge upstream backing capacities and recursive frames before allocation. Selected-tree node/depth thresholds apply before host-plan allocation. Source capture enforces its input ceiling before materialization. Retained source/host plans and snapshot copies consume aggregate program_state_bytes separately, including old/new overlap; the evaluator owns those leases.

diagnostics.location: Pinned source or destination at acceptance; the prepared change is stopped and retained.
diagnostics.help: Captured revisions are rechecked exactly; no refresh, rebase or rerun of the transform.

diagnostics.location: An accepted command write that cannot be saved.
diagnostics.help: Accepted changes are kept unsaved with their saved-file revision. Later operations do not run; inspect the retained change before choosing the next action.

source_locations.byte_offsets: zero-based UTF-8 byte offsets, end exclusive
source_locations.source_identity: submitted program digest or captured sourced-unit digest

compatibility.class: agent-public vocabulary when offered; additive pre-activation version 1 contract
compatibility.durable_changes: introducing producers must migrate records and generate consumers

retention: Screen source/output before retention. Active journal, review, held-effect and retained receipt references pin required bytes; expiry never authorizes collecting recovery inputs. No interpreter checkpoints.

platforms.macos: native runtime and installed qualification required later
platforms.linux: native runtime and installed qualification required later
platforms.windows: same contract; real adapter/confinement/egress/packaging prerequisites and native installed qualification in P30; shaped fixtures/compilation are not qualification

option_grammar.short_bundles: Boolean short options combine; a value option consumes the remaining suffix or next argv word. Explicitly exceptional forms override this rule.
option_grammar.long_values: Catalogued long value options accept --key=value or --key value unless a form states otherwise.
option_grammar.operand_boundary: -- ends option parsing; leading dash path operands require --. Operands remain bytes, never reparsed.
option_grammar.unsupported: Missing native forms may take a permitted confined native-gap launch. Otherwise refuse COMMAND_OPTION_UNSUPPORTED with the exact option span and generated help. Host-inspecting forms stay native; fallback never bypasses a host refusal.
option_grammar.conflicts: Reject COMMAND_OPERAND_INVALID for incompatible modes; never select a dialect from host OS.

schema_copy:
Run a short shell program; return when the next action needs interpretation. V1 supports quotes/escapes, pipes, ;, &&/||, grouping, variables with ${name:-word}/:=/#/%///:offset:len operators, indexed arrays, $(( )) and (( )) integer arithmetic, sorted globs, {a,b} and {1..5} braces, $()/backticks, <()/>() process substitution, if/case/for/while/until, time [-p], bounded functions, trap ... EXIT, set -e/-u/-o pipefail, source PATH, here-documents, <<< here-strings and redirects (>&2, 2>&1, N>&M). Syntax is validated before effects. Operations bind when reached; source validates its captured unit. Untaken branches do not expand. Eval uses the same admission. Associative arrays, non-EXIT traps, other shell options and persistent shell state are refused.
Native utilities: cat/head/tail/nl; find/grep/rg/tree; ls/stat/du/df/wc/diff/cmp/file/xxd/hexdump/od/strings; checksums/base64; sed/awk/printf/echo/seq/yes/sort/uniq/cut/tr/paste/join/comm/column/fold/tac/rev/iconv/envsubst/xargs; jq/yq; cp/mv/rm/rmdir/mkdir/touch/mktemp/tee; tar/unzip/zip/gzip/gunzip/zcat; Git; curl; path, environment, identity, date, session process, timeout/nohup and ulimit built-ins. Help lists forms. GNU/BSD sed -i, stat -c/-f and base64 -d/-D have fixed portable meanings. Missing native forms may launch a confined installed binary and record native_gap for native repair. Host-inspecting commands stay native/session-scoped. Fallback never bypasses a host refusal.
Other programs (python3, go, cargo, npm, node, ./task) run confined. Bare python uses python3 only when python is absent. external -- selects an installed binary over a native name. Arguments stay data; native_path -- PATH converts a logical cross-root path without granting access. Native absolute paths retain OS identity. TMPDIR, mktemp and children share the real session directory. Native null redirects are typed discard sinks.
Pipes carry complete bytes, separate from previews/receipts. Variables never become grammar. Unquoted expansion uses current IFS then sorted globs; quoting preserves argument boundaries. Unmatched globs stay literal. Substitution strips trailing LF and refuses NUL scalars; failed substitution prevents its containing dispatch. Native reads and external processes use saved file bytes. Unsaved human or mixed drafts stay separate; affected reads include a short note.
Redirects and in-place edits stage complete output, then review and compare captured destination revisions before publication. They never pre-truncate. Native grep no-match/diff/cmp differences keep status1 but can publish complete output. Failed/incomplete producers discard staging. Earlier committed effects remain after later failure; programs are not transactions. Permission refusal, conflict, cancellation and host budgets stop later admission even after exit0. When allowed, accepted agent-only edits publish through separate admitted writes before a reached owner opens inputs. Read-only profiles do not publish drafts.
Optional progress_update settles its existing payload separately before gated effects. Every effect retains its subsystem authority, source span, child identity, evidence and recovery. Internal execution reads are not conversational observation; only exact delivered mapped source windows establish an edit base. Surgical/orientation tools remain normally selectable.
Trailing & returns a session job. $! is its numeric PID or session job number; jobs, wait and kill accept that reference for session jobs, never an unrelated process. Approval resumes exact held inputs once. Host loss interrupts; it does not replay the program, HTTP or completed effects. Partial/unknown outcomes require a specific safe next action. Whole-program resubmission is suggested only with proved zero program effects and is never automatic. Secret references stay opaque except at declared authorized sinks.
